housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 651.64 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Bergamo city centre, based on 949 entries in the prior 12 months and last updated 20 August 2026; the opened source did not establish a deposit norm or main local rental portal.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that a foreign citizen resident in Italy may open its XME account only with an Italian codice fiscale; online identification for a new customer uses an accepted Italian identity document and, when requested, the health card.
required_docs: Accepted Italian identification document for online identification: electronic identity card, passport, or driving licence

schools.summary: The International School of Bergamo states that it is Bergamo's only authorised IB Continuum School and offers the International Baccalaureate across primary, middle, and high school years, including the Diploma Programme.
curricula: International Baccalaureate continuum, including the Diploma Programme

legal_admin.summary: A newcomer transferring from abroad to Bergamo must submit a residence declaration to the Comune di Bergamo, either online with CNS, SPID, or CIE authentication or in person by appointment.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the dichiarazione di residenza (residence declaration) to the Comune di Bergamo online with CNS, SPID, or CIE, or in person by appointment.

tax_finance.summary: A first Italian tax identification number requires an in-person appointment for identity verification; EU citizens apply at an Italian Revenue Agency office with the request and valid ID, while non-EU citizens may receive it through the immigration desk or Questura in specified immigration cases, otherwise through the Revenue Agency.

transport.summary: ATB's 2025 Mobility Charter lists a EUR 36 one-zone monthly pass. Driving-licence rules are from Italy's Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport at https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera and healthcare registration guidance is from ATS Bergamo at https://ats-bg.it/cittadini-comunitari.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences with EU-standard validity may be used until expiry and then converted at a Motorizzazione Civile office; non-EU/EEA licences may be used for up to one year after Italian residence with an international permit or official Italian translation, and conversion is available only where Italy has a reciprocity agreement, otherwise an Italian licence must be obtained by examination. Source: https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera
transport.healthcare_registration: For Bergamo, an eligible newcomer requests mandatory or voluntary SSR/SSN registration at the competent ASST territorial office; Bergamo city is served by ASST Papa Giovanni XXIII. Source: https://ats-bg.it/cittadini-comunitari
